title: Thymosin-alpha 1 for Adjuvant Treatment After Radical Resection of High-risk Stage II and III Colorectal Cancer
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Colorectal cancer receiving radical resection
* Pathologically diagnosed with high-risk stage II or stage III
* Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status of 0-2
* Adequate hepatic, renal, and hematologic function

Exclusion Criteria:

* Had previously taken any immune-promoting drugs
* Pregnancy or lactation
